# Bid the base and the waste, not the square footage.

> Price a paver patio from pattern waste, base depth, excavation, edge restraint, and haul-away — then see price per square foot, crew hours, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
